items.prompt: Why is A+1 a safe unreachable sentinel?

options.why: A is an upper bound on a reachable coin count, not the value of every answer.
Coins can exceed 1; the bound only needs every permitted coin to contribute at least one unit.
For nonnegative amount A and positive integer coins, any exact solution uses at most A coins, so A+1 lies beyond all reachable minima.
A may be zero; then dp[0]=0 is reachable and the sentinel is 1.
